scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 9 excellent with minor issues, 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Overall is a holistic judgment, not the mission outcome or arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, visually distinctive mission with useful touch assistance and objective feedback, held back by inconsistent apparent target centering, obstruction ambiguity and dense text at 844x390. Two wins do not by themselves establish quality or enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large anchored controls, tap aim, MOVE and two-contact FIRE worked in sampled situations. DASH feedback was clear. Route-facing changes and the right-side target tap complicated aiming. Brief drags do not establish fine control quality.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver recovery, armor windows, numbered coils and final upload formed a legible progression; managing rear pressure while focusing forward added observed tension. Route assistance dominated navigation and enabled substantial bypass of patrol combat, limiting assessment of manual traversal and sustained encounters.
reasons.presentation: Strong rainy industrial atmosphere, restrained cyan/amber palette and coherent title/result layouts. Judged visually only; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Visible fresh restart, paused map with completion markers, recovery confirmations and progress percentages reduced uncertainty. Empty-magazine reload required a FIRE action in the observed run; cover outcomes were sometimes difficult to diagnose.
reasons.readability: Core health/ammo/buttons and coil states readable; small environmental signage, compact hints, dense handbook and overlay competition strained the narrow landscape view. Handbook lower text was clipped behind its scroll area; it invited swiping but I did not fully scroll it.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good observed experience with meaningful friction; 10 exceptional and consistently clear. Subjective bounded review of observed portrait play, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification. Overall holistic, not arithmetic mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: Clear objective progression, coherent atmosphere and useful assistance made both sampled missions understandable. Portrait target size, crowded overlays and cover/no-impact feedback cost clarity. Paused assisted runs leave substantial manual-control and continuous-play uncertainty.
reasons.controls: Large anchored buttons, tap aim, TURN and two-contact MOVE/FIRE worked in brief samples. Scene swipe visibly turned, AIM showed sights. Precision, sustained manual traversal and physical ergonomics remain unassessed; assisted travel does not establish these.
reasons.gameplay: Observed sequence of recovery, coil disable and upload provided clear changing tasks with damage and reload decisions. Short assisted completion and segmented combat limit judgment of sustained challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial rain scene, strong title and terminal hierarchy, clear target/coil feedback. Dark geometry and overlapping scene text reduce visual clarity. Audio excluded.
reasons.usability: Visible handbook, contextual HOLD APPROACH, SAVED confirmation, paused planning map and readable fresh-start results reduced uncertainty. Several competing prompts and cover states still demand interpretation.
reasons.readability: Primary health/ammo/objective and terminal stats readable; small world lettering, Roman numerals, distant enemies and instructional overlays are harder to parse in 390px portrait.

interpretation: Both holistic mobile scores remain 7/10; wins do not establish exceptional quality. Raw reviews preserved.
